overview.title: Water and green near town
overview.p1: Source Tizguit is a local nature stop: spring water, greenery and a break from the main road. It suits travellers who want a simple outdoor hour without driving far into the mountains.
overview.p2: Wear shoes with grip if paths are wet. Bring water even though you are near a spring — do not assume potable fountains.
